entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support'.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally, a person. Listen, Alex, I bought a jersey from you guys almost a month ago and it's completely useless. I want to return it right now.

I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the material or a preference issue like the fit?

A preference issue? It's the wrong size! Your sizing chart is a joke. This jersey is way too tight, I can barely breathe in it. Don't waste my time with dumb questions, just process the return. If you don't, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. Get me a manager!

I understand your frustration, and I assure you, a manager isn't necessary. I can handle this for you. Let me just pull up your account. Can I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's sam.henderson@email.com. And it better be fast.
Thank you, Sam. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Aero Jersey, delivered 29 days ago. I also see you're one of our VIP members; we really appreciate your loyalty.
Then act like it. Am I getting my money back or not?

Absolutely. Our policy for standard items allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window. We can definitely process a full refund for you. Or, if you'd prefer, we can set up an exchange for the correct size right away.
Oh. Well... an exchange would be better, I guess. I do like the jersey's design.

Excellent. To apologize for the sizing confusion and the frustration it caused, I'll process that exchange for the next size up with complimentary expedited shipping. You should have the new jersey in 1-2 business days. I'll also email you a pre-paid return label for the one that's too tight.
Wow, okay. Expedited shipping? That's... actually very helpful. Thank you, Alex. I appreciate you sorting that out so quickly.

Of course, Sam. It's my pleasure. I've just processed the exchange. You should see the confirmation email in your inbox shortly, along with that return label. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for being a VeloFit VIP, and have a great rest of your day.
